text: inconsistent quality for all their sized candles.  disappointed.. the wax burns way tooo fast and dripped all over the place.  and the quality is irractice - one candle was fine and the next one just collapsed with mess of wax everywhere.  we have noticed this inconsistent quality across many of amazon branded candles - regardless of the size.  disappointing as the brand is often very good.
